card.name: Separator inside multi-digit numbers
card.fires_on: A decimal point or thousands comma that comes right after the first two or three digits of a number. It appears in tables, dose lists, file sizes, prices and statistics.

modes.label: Decimal point
modes.description: The period between whole digits and decimals in a dose, size or price.
modes.example: Three capsules (223<<.>>5 mg) orally every 8 hours

modes.label: Thousands comma
modes.description: The comma after leading digits in a large count or volume.

card.plain: It fires on the dot or comma in the middle of a number, just before the remaining digits.
